description: Submit the already reviewed allocation using locally produced owner Safe signatures. This can move owner funds into the owner capital account. No private key or email code is accepted. Preserve the operation ID and key on timeout; read get_arc_home_operation rather than creating a replacement allocation.

confirm.description: Must be true after the owner reviews this exact action.

idempotency_key.description: Required durable retry key. Preserve it and the exact request after an uncertain result.

safe_signatures.description: Map of reviewed Safe transaction hash to locally produced owner signature.

name: submit_capital_allocation
